add.title: Add a mailbox
add.text: Sign in to another mailbox to use it alongside your current ones.
add.reconnectText: The mail server rejected the saved credentials for {{email}}. Enter the current password.

reconnect.title: Sign in again to {{email}}
reconnect.text: The mail server rejected the password. It may have changed.

logout.confirmText: Its cache, local drafts and pending actions will be erased from this device. Nothing is deleted on the mail server.

logoutAll.confirmText: Your session ends and everything cached on this device is erased.

section.intro: Mailboxes open in this session. Credentials are encrypted on the server and never come back to the browser. The order sets the Ctrl+1…9 shortcuts.
section.storedOnDevice: Password stored on this device, encrypted
section.storedTokenOnDevice: API token stored on this device, encrypted

tray.backgroundNotice: Voxel keeps running in the notification area to tell you about new mail. You can change this in Settings.
